metadata.title: Zan & Rokpi Takeng | Millet Porridge & Egg Chutney | Monpa Recipe
metadata.description:
Zan is a rustic staple dish of the Monpa people who inhabit the high altitude district of Tawang in Arunachal Pradesh. It is an easy to prepare dish prepared by adding millet flour to boiling water and topping it up by adding in some vegetables. 

Rokpi Takeng is a simple Monpa style chutney made of hard boiled eggs and grated ginger which features commonly in a Monpa platter. This chutney is good to go with meals and even as spread on rotis and on breads.
